scope: Partial chapter 8 lexical support: first 105 fixed objects S1770–S1874 / 38 pairs MTP-000568–MTP-000605 reviewed against actual English and all 24 translator notes. Remaining 179 objects not reconciled.
policy: Compact records group actual source loci and reader-linked local notes. All provisional usages remain proposed. Unrendered unresolved Tibetan is retained in the relevant construction record and receives no invented lexical equivalent. Routine canonical repetitions and ordinary function words are excluded unless a material disclosed construction requires review.

records.condition_evidence: Predication and supplied subject remain provisional. The following positive-looking དངོས་ཏེ at S1788 is retained visibly unresolved in the same reviewed pair, not silently normalized.

records.english_realization: empty yet appearing, appearing yet empty
records.condition_evidence: Both orders and both repetitions retained. The following S1794 དངོས་ཏེ remains visibly unresolved, not absorbed into this grammatical equivalence.

records.english_realization: [it] abides empty from the primordial beginning
records.condition_evidence: Abiding is verbally realized; the exhaustion subject is not named, and the supplied continuing it remains explicit.

Primordial is expressed by ཡེ and does not replace the established radiance head. Distinct from limpid དངས.

Canonical free-from-grasping and clarity provisionally qualify object-appearance; no named vision is substituted.

Manifest qualifier and instrumental realization are preserved without equating the construction to canonical direct perception.

records.english_realization: Through the three aspects of the key points

Plural embodies explicit five and terminative case; supplied it provisionally refers to awareness. It does not substitute the prior three-embodiment expression.

records.english_realization: Through basic space and awareness arising, objects and ordinary mind cease
records.condition_evidence: Both compressed compounds are provisionally coordinated; all four lexical components remain recoverable and cessation scope stays flagged.

records.english_realization: Of the Tathāgata’s intrinsic nature, clearly distinguish the core of the continuum

records.english_realization: the Ground, core and quintessence themselves
records.condition_evidence: Ground remains canonical within the stated threefold list; repetition of core as heading and member is not repaired.

records.english_realization: essence, intrinsic nature and compassionate responsiveness pervade all and appear
records.condition_evidence: Complete canonical triad retained under the Ground; extending the following predicates to the triad is provisional and compressed topic attachment remains open.
Plural realizes explicit three; no names of the three are invented.

records.english_realization: Embodiment is the family in which the core is complete; Embodiment’s continuum is pervaded by emptiness
records.condition_evidence: Subject embodiment, family completion relation and explicit continuum genitive remain separate; no embodiment name is supplied.

records.english_realization: Clarity itself is also self-appearance; non-appearing clarity
records.condition_evidence: Self-appearance remains the established whole expression; the next non-appearing modifier is tentatively attached to clarity and its negation is retained.

records.english_realization: the intrinsic nature in which the core is complete: [རྒྱད: unresolved]
records.condition_evidence: Canonical intrinsic nature remains visible, while the unusual final syllable is retained verbatim and unresolved. No proposed equivalence to continuum or silent spelling normalization is introduced.

validation.status: All recorded exact spans, fixed-source pair allocation, actual reader-note references and note-map bindings checked; no errors.
validation.review_limits: Author-side support for first batch only; 179 objects remain unreconciled. A locus is a record/source-object span, not token count. Independent QC is separate.

glossary_search: All 222 complete eight-column rows read. Whole expressions, exact forms, source construction, canonical families and English collisions considered; no fuzzy spelling identity or prior-proposal approval inferred.
